com.addr.hunterj.jdbc
Interface NestedQueryExecutor

public interface NestedQueryExecutor

NestedQueryExecutor provides a mechanism whereby JdbcQueryHandlers can be nested. This supports queries that must contain multiple open Statements. This mechanism is necessary since the default behavior allows only one Statement per query. NestedQueryExecutor is implemented within QueryManager and supplied to each JdbcQueryHandler. The user does not invoke the implemented object directly, but, instead, uses, JdbcQueryHandler.executeNested(JdbcQueryHandler) to execute a nested JdbcQueryHandler.
